title: Stopped Working after about two months
text: Stopped Working after about two months. I bought this to put in my office at work, only used it during the work day (8hrs x5 days/week), using clean drinking water.  I had one of these about 10 years ago (different brand, I'm sure of it, but same basic design) and it lasted for about 6 years in my home with near constant use until I broke the bowl in a move.  The ionizing part on this one appears cheap...the ceramic looks to be 'plated' on versus having an actual ceramic 'wafer'.  When this one stopped working, I noticed the ceramic had flaked away, basically rendering it useless for its intended purpose.  I would go with a higher-rated model if you're interested in one of these.  I'll probably seek out and buy a better ionizer to use in this one as I definitely notice a difference in my well-being with this neutralizing the static air, particulates, and most importantly, EMF generated by two computers and 3 screens in my office.
